ecological_question: At which nested spatial level is temporal population variability reduced: among subcolonies within breeding islands, or among islands within the Palmer Archipelago?

framing.link_to_neff: The N_eff result motivates a scale question: whether spatial organization within islands contains more temporal compensation than island-to-island dynamics.

primary_units.reason: Only islands with an unchanged reported colony-code roster across the complete 1991-2017 census are eligible for the primary subcolony-to-island decomposition.

nested_primary_decomposition.alpha_subcolony_cv2: Wang-Loreau alpha variability across every stable colony code nested in COR/HUM/LIT
nested_primary_decomposition.alpha_island_cv2: Wang-Loreau alpha variability treating COR/HUM/LIT island totals as local units
nested_primary_decomposition.gamma_archipelago_cv2: Wang-Loreau gamma variability of the summed COR/HUM/LIT total

pre_litchfield_extinction.purpose: check that the hierarchy ordering is not created by post-extinction zeros on Litchfield

persistent_stable_roster_only.purpose: remove Litchfield entirely while retaining only stable colony-code rosters

five_island_archipelago.purpose: describe island-to-archipelago variability without requiring colony-code continuity

centered_signal_sensitivities.reported_metric: covariance-based spatial synchrony phi and beta=1/phi only
centered_signal_sensitivities.important_boundary: Do not report alpha/gamma CV for centered residuals or growth because their means can be zero or negative; the raw-abundance Wang-Loreau CV decomposition is the primary hierarchy result.

interpretation_boundary: beta>1 indicates temporal compensation/asynchrony, not a demonstrated causal spatial-insurance mechanism
the decomposition does not identify movement or dispersal among colony codes
colony codes are census units and are not assumed to be one-to-one GIS subcolony polygons
the analysis is descriptive and uses the already-opened long-term census; no confirmatory p-value is attached to the hierarchy ordering
